name: work-alerts
description: Alerts for long tasks finishing, failed checks, subagents finishing, and context or usage limit warnings, by popup, sound and macOS notification

enabled.title: Work alerts
enabled.description: Off stops all the alerts below.

sound.title: Alert sound
sound.description: Plays a short sound with each alert. /task-alert also turns it on and off.

desktop.title: macOS popup
desktop.description: Shows a notification at the top right when a long task finishes or stops.

longTurn.title: Long task threshold
longTurn.description: Alerts when a reply that took longer than this finishes.

subagent.title: Subagent done alerts
subagent.description: How to alert when a subagent finishes. When several finish together, the sound plays once.
